messages:
maya (support): Hey team — customer 'EduWave' (PO: PO-7788) says their mid-cycle downgrade credit is wrong. They bumped to Pro then downgraded to Basic on 2026-02-10. Invoice shows a credit of -€1,452 but customer claims PO exempts VAT so net should be -€1,200. Can finance confirm?

liam (finance): @maya can you paste the invoice lines and the credit note id?

maya (support): Invoice #INV-2026-0897, credit note CN-2026-302. Relevant snippet copied from portal: 
```
Line 1: Subscription Pro (2026-02-01 -> 2026-03-01) EUR 4,000
Line 2: Prorated downgrade (2026-02-10 -> 2026-03-01) -EUR 1,200
Line 3: VAT 21% on credit EUR 252
Total Credit: -EUR 1,452
PO: PO-7788 (tax_exempt flag in PO notes)
```

sophie (acct-manager): Did the original invoice for the period have PO applied as tax-exempt? If the original was taxed, reversing it might keep tax. Need to check whether we applied tax_exempt at invoice creation.

arthur (tax): Quick note — for credit notes we mirror tax treatment of the original invoice lines unless a tax_exempt flag is explicitly set on the credit note. Many customers expect tax reversal on a credit when the PO is tax-exempt, but if the system treated the original as taxable, the credit will include VAT.

maya (support): EduWave insists their PO included a VAT exemption reference. They attached a signed PO with VAT exemption code: EU-EXEMPT-2024. I dropped it in the support ticket.

liam (finance): Ok, repro steps I ran: 1) create subscription 2026-02-01 2) simulate upgrade to Pro then downgrade 2026-02-10 3) system auto-generates credit note. When I create the credit via the billing UI, there's no checkbox to toggle tax_exempt on the generated credit — it follows the invoice metadata.

liam (finance): If the original invoice didn't have the PO meta (po_number / tax_exempt) present at creation time, the credit won't be tax_exempt. Did the customer add PO after initial billing?

maya (support): They did — they sent PO after first invoice was generated. Support attached PO to the customer record last week. Tick in UI shows "PO on account" now. But invoice history shows original invoice metadata lacks po_number.

arthur (tax): That matches expected cause. For mid-cycle prorations the sequence is: compute prorated amount, compute tax based on invoice-level tax settings, then emit credit. If PO metadata is retroactively added, system doesn't recompute existing invoice taxes automatically.

sophie (acct-manager): Options: 1) Issue an adjusted credit note reversing VAT separately (manual tax adjustment), 2) Recompute and reissue the original invoice & credit (systemically correct but more invasive), 3) Issue a partial refund for the net amount and leave VAT collected, then work offline to refund VAT. Which do we prefer?

liam (finance): For EDU customers usually we honor PO tax-exempt. I vote for issuing a corrected credit note that removes VAT. We should also log a small internal incident to track root cause: PO applied late.

maya (support): Customer prefers corrected credit note. They asked for timing — can we do this today?

liam (finance): I can do a manual adjustment now. Steps I'll take: 
1) Create a manual credit note CN-2026-302-A referencing CN-2026-302
2) Set tax_exempt = true on the manual credit 
3) Apply credit to open balance or refund if no balance.

liam (finance): Manual calculation: original credit -EUR 1,452. Remove VAT (EUR 252) => corrected credit -EUR 1,200. We'll issue CN-2026-302-A for -EUR 1,200 and mark CN-2026-302 as superseded.

billing-bot: ACTION LOG: Created internal task FIN-8763 to track EduWave PO retroactive tax exemption. Assigned to liam (finance).

arthur (tax): Please attach PO PDF and note the legal basis for exemption in FIN-8763. Also ensure we record the customer VAT id and exemption code for audit.

liam (finance): Will attach now. Repro notes for engineering/ops: If you want to automate a correction path we need a workflow that: detect PO added after invoice creation -> optionally reissue invoice/credit with recomputed tax OR create a reversing tax-only credit. Currently UI doesn't surface "apply PO retroactively" workflow.

maya (support): I've messaged the customer: we'll issue corrected credit note today and confirm once posted. They replied :pray::"thank you, appreciate the quick turnaround"

sophie (acct-manager): Quick FYI — if a customer pays via card and there is no outstanding balance, we need to refund the net difference (EUR 1,200) back to card. If they have an open balance we can leave it as credit. Check payment method on invoice.

liam (finance): Payment method was card (last4 **** 4242) and payment cleared. We'll refund EUR 1,200 to the card and post CN-2026-302-A to reconcile.

maya (support): Customer updated ticket confirming they want refund to card. 

liam (finance): Refund initiated. I'll update FIN-8763 and paste refund id when done.

billing-bot: ACTION LOG: Refund EUR 1,200 processed (REF-4521). Credit note CN-2026-302-A created and applied. FIN-8763 updated.

maya (support): Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

liam (finance): Follow-up: we should add a small UI hint when attaching a PO to a customer that it won't retroactively change existing invoices, and offer a one-click "recompute taxes for affected invoices" for admins. Filing feature request: FEATURE-1991.

arthur (tax): Also add guidance in billing playbook about issuing tax-only reversing credits vs full reissue. I'll draft short doc.

sophie (acct-manager): Thanks — that will reduce friction for EDU / government customers.

maya (support): Thread closed for now, will reopen if customer reports any discrepancy after refund.
